title: Squash Jjigae aux Fromages
description: A French-inspired twist on Korean jjigae, featuring roasted squash, melted cheese, and a hint of buttery goodness.
instructions: Toss the squash in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the squash on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the jjigae and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the Gruyère and goat cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the roasted squash to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with thyme and adjust seasoning as needed.
